# Vendored dependency

`coolxer-secure-communication-js-0.2.0.tgz` is the npm package artifact for
`@coolxer/secure-communication-js@0.2.0`, built from secure-communication commit
`1993eb55cabd4c795b59c56dae7a31727625c69a`.

The tarball is used until the package is available from the organization registry.
Regenerate it from the reviewed dependency checkout with:

```bash
npm pack /path/to/secure-communication/client/javascript --ignore-scripts --pack-destination ./vendor
```
